Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Railway CLI volume delete: how to stop it

What happens

Railway CLI volume delete. The call below tries to delete a cloud volume. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Railway.

The call

railway volume delete --yes

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Keep backups outside the Railway project, so one command cannot delete a volume and its only backup. A project token reaches one environment of one project, so it limits the damage of a misused token but does not stop a volume delete.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule railway-volume-delete, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
